name: spec-lint
body: The `apg spec lint` binary subcommand and its `apg_spec_lint` suite tool: the deterministic spec-integrity check over the whole durable spec (R2/R3/R4 and the delta gates) plus the shared wording-warning classifier that the linter and the `apg node add` / `apg node update` write surface both call. The `apg spec` subcommand dispatches from `rust.apg.main`. The write-surface warning hooks are `rust.apg.node_cmd.node_add_change` and `rust.apg.node_cmd.node_update_change`; the suite registry is `src/install.rs`.
